$schema_note: Deterministic rules the gamification engine applies over current-vs-previous scan JSON. Editing this file re-tunes XP/levels/achievements without touching the collector or the dashboard. Kept separate from per-scan data so the rules are versioned independently.

level_curve.description: Cumulative XP thresholds. Account/project level = highest tier whose threshold <= xp. Titles are flavor only.

project_score.description: Per-scan project score (a snapshot of current standing). xp_breakdown stores each line. Account XP accrues from quest completions + streaks over time, NOT from re-counting snapshots, so leveling reflects real progress rather than a static state.

xp_awards.description: Account XP (cumulative, what drives leveling). Awarded by the engine when the diff detects the event.

spellcraft.description: Spellbook economy. Cast XP is flavor income — deliberately small and capped so quests stay the primary economy; casting one spell 50x/day earns the same as casting it once. Mastery counts DISTINCT DAYS used, never raw casts (grind-proof). Settlement happens in assemble.mjs only, from spell-telemetry.json, watermarked so each cast is counted once.

streak.description: Scan streak = consecutive calendar days with at least one scan. Resets if a day is missed. Bonus XP per maintained day via xp_awards.streak_day.

health_index.description: Composite 0-100 workspace health for the headline gauge. Weighted blend, clamped 0-100.

components.build_score: percent of products with build in {green, runs}
components.risk_score: high_flags*20 + medium_flags*8 + min(detected_secrets*4, 60), capped 100 (detected secrets count even before the LLM grades their severity)
components.test_coverage_score: percent of products with a real passing test suite

git_risk_rules.description: Deterministic mapping from git_safety facts to risk level.
